label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The issue occurs because the BASE_URL for password reset links defaults to "http://localhost:3000" if the environment variable PUBLIC_URL is not set. This causes the email to include localhost URLs, which are not valid for most users outside the developer's machine.

To fix this, the deployment environment should set the PUBLIC_URL environment variable to the correct base URL for the production app. This change will ensure that password reset emails contain valid, reachable links instead of localhost URLs.

This is consistent with the code in src/notifications/templates.ts, where BASE_URL falls back to localhost in the absence of PUBLIC_URL, explaining the behavior the users experienced since the last release.

input.title: Fix password reset email URL to use config base URL instead of default localhost
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email uses a base URL derived from process.env.PUBLIC_URL or defaults to "http://localhost:3000" if not set. This causes the reset password links in the email to point to localhost for users when the environment variable is missing or undefined.

The proposed change is to use the application's config base URL instead of falling back to "http://localhost:3000". This will ensure the password reset links in emails point to the correct public URL in all environments, preventing broken links to localhost.
